tldr: Speaker 1 described a web portal for a customer who imports CSVs from Manhattan (WMS): a holding area to validate, edit, search and manifest consignments before pushing to Selector.
Harry thinks Fuse may not be the right base and that building it outside Fuse would simplify things and help maintainability, though Fuse building blocks can be reused.

Rough shape: an SFTP host with validation, a UI showing the import queue with edits and search, and label printing. Selector handles label creation and manifesting, with an end-of-day CSV exported back to Manhattan.

Validation will be done in the app as far as possible, with Selector as a last resort; printing approach is unresolved because the printers are unknown and Dispatch Cloud's QZ Tray approach may not apply.
Harry will go through the notes overnight, draft plans and design docs, and they will catch up on Thursday.
decisions: Do validation in the application as much as possible and use Selector's validate call only as a last resort.
Make the portal web-driven with nothing installed locally, if it can be avoided.
Lean towards building this outside Fuse, pending Harry reviewing the notes.

actions.text: Send Harry the plan and notes document for the portal.
Review the notes overnight and put as much as possible into Confluence/Jira with a plan of attack.
Put design docs together for the SFTP host with validation, the queue UI and printing.
Find out what label printers the customer uses and which label format (ZPL or EPL) applies.
Point the knowledge system at the existing ZPL/EPL documentation as prior art for printing.
Message Speaker 1 on the day about meeting in the office or on a huddle.
Ping Harry if actions come out of the planning that need starting tonight, and handle the Selector side.

questions: Should this be built on Fuse or outside it? Harry leans towards outside but wants to review first.
How will label printing work from a web UI, given Dispatch Cloud uses QZ Tray (paid) and nothing local is wanted? WebUSB was floated.
Which label printers does the customer have, and in what format (ZPL or EPL)?
How can useful validation errors be returned, since Selector's validate call sometimes returns only a generic error?
How will the four customer mapping requirements (e.g. consignment number and ship ref relating to their system) be handled?
Will Speaker 1 come into the office on Thursday or join a huddle?
